'''R2-N3''' was a green [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]], along with [[R2-M5/Legends|R2-M5]], was blasted off the hull<ref name="TPMEVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> while fixing an imbalance on the starboard [[Engine/Legends|engines]] on [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] ship while escaping the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] blockade of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The other droids [[R2-R9/Legends|R2-R9]], [[R2-B1/Legends|R2-B1]] and [[G8-R3/Legends|G8-R3]] were destroyed outright.<ref name="TPMEVD" />
